Container.Name: rom-sync
Container.Overview: Browse the whole lolroms.com catalog in a web page, tick the folders you want, and keep them in sync. Only new, incomplete or changed files are downloaded, file dates match the website, parallel downloads tune themselves to what the server allows, and it can re-sync on a schedule.

Config.Name: Downloads
Config.Description: Where synced files go (pick a share). The site's folder structure is kept below this folder.

Config.Name: App data
Config.Description: Catalog, settings and your folder selection.

Config.Name: Password
Config.Description: Optional. When set, the browser asks for it (any user name).

Config.Name: Time zone
Config.Description: Used for file dates and the sync schedule.

Config.Name: PUID
Config.Description: User that owns downloaded files (99 = nobody).

Config.Name: PGID
Config.Description: Group that owns downloaded files (100 = users).

Config.Name: UMASK
Config.Description: 000 = files readable and writable by everyone on the share.
